title: Garrett Wilson: We have to give our fans a reason to come out

sources.title: Garrett Wilson: We have to give our fans a reason to come out
sources.description: If someone flipped on Sunday's game between the Raiders and the Jets in the fourth quarter, they would have been forgiven for wondering if the Raiders were the home team at MetLife Stadium.
